findings.desc: docs/requirements/decisions/story-lifecycle.md:136 says phase=INIT without recorded worktree.path is parked backlog, but the implemented convergence check also treats an actual linked git worktree branch story/<id> as active even when metadata lacks worktree.path. This underdocuments the active-worktree blocker rule requested by the story and contradicted by convergence-discarded-smoke runtimeWorktreeStoryId assertions at packages/main/src/tasks/convergence-discarded-smoke.ts:128-140. Update the parked backlog paragraph to require both no recorded worktree.path and no linked git worktree branch before a story is advisory parked backlog.
